description: This file defines internal structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing DHCPv6 within the WAN Manager component, including data structures for DHCPv6 client and server info, and function declarations for DHCPv6 operations.

classes.name: DHCPCV6_CONTEXT_LINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Structure representing DHCPv6 client context with linked list and server/receive entries.

classes.name: WAN_DHCPV6_DATA
classes.description: Structure holding DHCPv6 data including client and pool lists, aliases, and configuration.

methods.name: WanMgr_Dhcpv6Create
methods.description: Creates a new DHCPv6 management object.

methods.name: WanMgr_Dhcpv6ClientHasDelayAddedChild
methods.description: Checks if DHCPv6 client has a delay-added child context.

methods.name: WanMgr_DmlSetIpaddr
methods.description: Sets IP address based on provided address and string.
